author: Camemes
body:
Hey Guys,

So I decided to make this series to showcase some of Avicus's really, really good bridgers, so I decided to do a series on my YouTube channel called "So You Think You Can Bridge?!?" (Hence given the name) is where people send me clips of them bridging and I make a top 10 montage or something like that! I think it would be really cool!! For more information on the series and on how you can enter is on a video on my channel. It doesn't necessarily have to be a good bridge, it could be an epic bridge fail, or a good one, just one that people would want to see! 

Video: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=VFAWTpQ8tPQ
Channel: https://www.youtube.com/channel/UC2v42hHP6ARf8Tz-YysjhiQ

I hope to get a few clips and can't wait for episode 1 to be released but I need clips first so please send me the clips by email at drfrankensheamus@gmail.com so I can make the first episode of So You Think You Can Bridge?!?
